lines.text: Two blind men follow Jesus, crying out for mercy and calling Him Son of David.
In the house, the blind men say yes to Jesus' question, and He touches their eyes.
Jesus says it will be done according to their effort, their eyes are opened, and He sternly warns them.
The healed men spread the news, and a mute man with a demon speaks after the demon is driven out.
The crowds are afraid and say nothing like this was seen in Israel, but the Pharisees credit the prince of demons.
